## Hypothesis

This analysis summarizes the Stage-1 backtest results for the base engine (no changes) to fill missing OP-20 disclosures (account-size assumption, sample bias) and determine if edge_capture meets the OP-16 threshold (≥771) for proceeding to OOS walk-forward and real-fills validation.

## Mechanism

The Stage-1 backtest uses BS-synthetic option pricing over historical SPY/VIX bars (as noted in the engine note) with an empty combo (i.e., baseline engine configuration). It computes P&L per J anchor day and aggregates edge_capture as defined by OP-16: sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers).
